mapper.sql: plan_id, user_id, start_date, end_date, daily_target_minutes, remark, status, ongoing_unique, finish_time, create_time, update_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO exercise_plan ( plan_id, user_id, start_date, end_date, daily_target_minutes, remark, status, ongoing_unique, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{planId}, #{userId}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{dailyTargetMinutes}, #{remark}, #{status}, #{ongoingUnique}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE exercise_plan SET status = #{status}, ongoing_unique = #{ongoingUnique}, finish_time = #{finishTime}, update_time = NOW() WHERE plan_id = #{planId}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM exercise_plan WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 1 LIMIT 1
